title: Ted Baker Fusion Midnight Petal Body & Hair Mist 200ml

  • Range: Fusion

  • Scent profile: Floral · Gourmand · Amber

  • Gourmand-floral scent with a warm base
  • Use on body and hair
  • With glycerin and pro-vitamin B5
  • Light, airy mist

What does it smell like?

Vanilla, bergamot and orchid with rose, jasmine and brown sugar over amber, tonka and patchouli.
